title: Local File Inclusion (LFI) / Path Traversal
description: The application includes or reads files using a user-controlled path without proper validation, allowing an attacker to traverse the filesystem and read arbitrary files (such as configuration files or credentials). In certain configurations, inclusion of attacker-influenced content can escalate to code execution.
businessImpact: High --- disclosure of sensitive files such as configuration and credential stores can enable further compromise, and some setups allow escalation to code execution.
remediation:
- Avoid passing user input to file-system or include paths; map input to a fixed allow-list of identifiers.
- Canonicalize and validate paths, rejecting traversal sequences.
- Run the application with least privilege and restrict file-system access.
- Disable dangerous language features (e.g., remote includes) and store sensitive files outside web-accessible paths.
